# The purpose of this R code is to perform primary analysis on the merged datasets from US, Japan, Spain, Italy, UK, FR, GE.

#### GERAS-EU ####
# demographics
```{r demorel import}
des_eu <- read.csv(paste0(raw_eu_dir, "geras_EU_demorel.csv"), header=TRUE, sep=",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings="NA")
dim(des_eu)
```

```{r}
table(des_eu$DEMOTYPE, useNA = "ifany")
table(des_eu$VISITID, useNA = "ifany")
table(des_eu$COUNTRY, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
table(des_eu$SEX, useNA = "ifany")
table(des_eu$SEXLNM, useNA = "ifany")
table(des_eu$SEX, des_eu$DEMOTYPE, useNA = "ifany")
table(des_eu$SEX, des_eu$COUNTRY, useNA = "ifany")
```


# Separate dataset for patient demographics (demotype=1)
```{r filtering demoral}
despat_eu <- des_eu %>%
  filter((DEMOTYPE == 1), (VISID == 1)) %>%
  select(SUBJID, COUNTRYL, TRTSORT, SEX, SEXLNM, ENTAGE, DEMOTYPE)

duplicates <- duplicated(despat_eu$SUBJID)
duplicate_rows <- despat_eu[duplicates,]
print(duplicate_rows)
```

```{r}
despat_eu2 <- despat_eu %>%
  filter(!is.na(SEX))
```

# Separate dataset for caregiver demographics (demotype=6)
```{r filtering demoral}
descar_eu <- des_eu %>%
  filter((DEMOTYPE == 6), (VISID == 1)) %>%
  select(SUBJID, SEX, SEXLNM, ENTAGE, DEMOTYPE)
```


```{r filtering demoral}
duplicates <- duplicated(descar_eu$SUBJID) | duplicated(descar_eu$SUBJID, fromLast = TRUE)
duplicate_rows <- descar_eu[duplicates,]
print(duplicate_rows)
table(duplicate_rows$SUBJID)
pat_w_multi_cargivers <- unique(duplicate_rows$SUBJID)
```



## Removing participants with duplicated SUBJID (i.e., multiple caregivers) from descar_eu dataset
```{r}
descar_eu2 <- descar_eu %>%
  group_by(SUBJID) %>%
  filter(n() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r filtering demoral}
descar_eu3 <- descar_eu2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(SEX))
```



```{r remove duplicates}
duplicates <- duplicated(descar_eu3$SUBJID) | duplicated(descar_eu3$SUBJID, fromLast = TRUE)
duplicate_rows <- descar_eu3[duplicates,]
print(duplicate_rows)
```

## Patient characteristics
```{r}

```

```{r}
comorbid_eu2 <- comorbid_eu %>% filter(MHTYPE==1, VISID == 1) #Restrict to patient

comorbid_eu3  <- comorbid_eu2 %>%
```

## Merged Geras-EU dataset
```{r merged datasets}
merged_eu1 <- merge(merge(merge(merge(merge(merge(merge(despat_eu2, descar_eu3, by = "SUBJID"), desc_eu3, by = "SUBJID"), zbi_eu2, by = "SUBJID"), rud_eu2, by = "SUBJID"), cost_eu2, by="SUBJID"), educ_eu2, by="SUBJID"), mmse_eu2, by="SUBJID")
dim(merged_eu1)
```

## Cleaning the dataset
```{r cleaning dataset}
merged_eu2 <- merged_eu1 %>%
  rename(P_AGE = ENTAGE.x, P_SEX = SEXLNM.x, COUNTRY = COUNTRYL, CG_SEX = SEXLNM.y, CG_AGE = ENTAGE.y, CG_REL = DMRELLNM, CG_LIVEIN = CWTPTLNM, SEVGRPCD = TRTSORT, ZBITOTB = ZBIRN, CG_OTHCG = RUDRC, P_EDUC = EDCRN, MMSETOTB = MMSERN) %>%
  filter(! is.na(COUNTRY)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(P_AGE), !is.na(P_SEX), !is.na(CG_AGE), !is.na(CG_SEX), !is.na(CG_LIVEIN), !is.na(CG_OTHCG), !is.na(CG_REL), !is.na(ZBITOTB), !is.na(SEVGRPCD), P_AGE != ".") %>% 
   mutate (P_AGE= ifelse(P_AGE == ">89", "90", P_AGE),
           P_AGE1= as.numeric(P_AGE),
           CG_AGE= ifelse(CG_AGE == ">89", "90", CG_AGE),
           CG_AGE2= as.numeric(CG_AGE),
          P_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(P_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 65 & P_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 75 & P_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          CG_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(CG_AGE2 <65, "1", ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 65 & CG_AGE2 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 75 & CG_AGE2 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          P_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(P_SEX == "Male" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_SEX== "Male" , "1", "2")), 
         P_EDUC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_EDUC <= 12, "1", "2")),
         CG_OTHCG1=as.factor(ifelse(CG_OTHCG==0, "0", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 2, "2", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         SEVGRP= as.factor(SEVGRPCD),
         CG_LIVEIN1= as.factor (ifelse(CG_LIVEIN == "Yes" , "1", "2")),
         CG_REL1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_REL %in% c("Husband", "Wife"), 1, ifelse(CG_REL == "Child", 2, 3)))) %>%
dplyr::select(SUBJID, COUNTRY, P_SEX1, P_AGE1, CG_AGE2,CG_SEX1, CG_LIVEIN1, CG_OTHCG1, CG_REL1, ZBITOTB, COSTQSNUM, COSPR1RN, P_AGECAT, CG_AGECAT, P_EDUC1, MMSETOTB)
dim(merged_eu2)
```

```{r}
merged_eu2 %>%
  filter(COSTQSNUM == "COSTPADNM") 
```



# Final merge: Longer format to wider format dataset

#Final dataset (Sample size = 1480, FR: 415, UK: 521, GR: 544)
```{r merge final}
merged_eu4 <- merged_eu2 %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = COSTQSNUM,
    values_from = COSPR1RN,
    names_prefix = "COST_")
dim(merged_eu4)

table(merged_eu4$COUNTRY)
```

# add combordity
```{r}
merged_eu4_plus <- merge(merged_eu4, comorbid_eu3, by="SUBJID")
```

save the cleaned dataset
```{r}
save(merged_eu4, file = paste0(datadir,"EU.RData"))

save(merged_eu4_plus, file = paste0(datadir,"EU_plus.RData"))
```

# Merged US dataset
```{r merge demorel, demoralc, educ, zbi, mmse datasets}
merged_us1 <- merge(merge(merge(merge(merge(des_us2, desc_us2, by = "SUBJID"), educ_us2, by = "SUBJID"), zbi_us2, by = "SUBJID"), mmse_us2, by = "SUBJID"), cost_us2, by="SUBJID")
P_EDUC <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5) 
dim(merged_us1)
```
# Cleaning the dataset

```{r renaming new numeric age variables}
merged_us2 <- merged_us1 %>% 
   rename(P_AGE = ENTAGE.x, P_SEX = SEX.x, P_EDUC= SOCIOPRN, CG_AGE = ENTAGE.y, CG_SEX=SEX.y, CG_LIVEIN = CARWTPAT, CG_OTHCG = NUMCGVR, CG_REL = DMREL, ZBITOTB = ZBIRN, MMSETOTB = MMSERN ) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(P_AGE), !is.na(P_SEX), !is.na(P_EDUC), !is.na(CG_AGE), !is.na(CG_SEX), !is.na(CG_LIVEIN), !is.na(CG_OTHCG), !is.na(CG_REL), !is.na(ZBITOTB), !is.na(MMSETOTB), !is.na(MMSESEV), !is.na(ETHNIC)) %>% 
  mutate (P_AGE = ifelse(P_AGE == ">89", "90", P_AGE),
          P_AGE1=  as.numeric(P_AGE),
          CG_AGE = ifelse(CG_AGE == ">89", "90", CG_AGE),  
          CG_AGE1= as.numeric(CG_AGE),
          P_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(P_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 65 & P_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 75 & P_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          CG_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(CG_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(CG_AGE1 >= 65 & CG_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(CG_AGE1 >= 75 & CG_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          P_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(P_SEX == "1" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_SEX== "1" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_OTHCG1=as.factor(ifelse(CG_OTHCG==0, "0", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 2, "2", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         CG_LIVEIN1= as.factor (ifelse(CG_LIVEIN == "1" , "1", "2")),
         P_EDUC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_EDUC %in% c(1,2,3,4), "1", "2")),
         SEVGRP = case_when(MMSETOTB >=21 ~ 1, MMSETOTB >= 15 & MMSETOTB <= 20 ~ 2, MMSETOTB <= 14 ~ 3),
         COSPR1RN= round(COSPR1RN, digits = 2),
         CG_REL1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_REL== 1, 1, ifelse(CG_REL == 3 , 2, 3)))) %>%
select(SUBJID, COUNTRY,  P_SEX1, P_AGE1, P_AGECAT, P_EDUC1,  CG_AGE1, CG_AGECAT, CG_SEX1, CG_LIVEIN1, CG_OTHCG1, CG_REL1, ZBITOTB, MMSETOTB, COSTQSNUM, COSPR1RN)
dim(merged_us2)
#View(merged_us2)
```
# Final merge: Longer format to wider format dataset
```{r merge final}
constant_value <-0
merged_us3 <- merged_us2 %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = COSTQSNUM,
    values_from = COSPR1RN,
    names_prefix = "COST_")
dim(merged_us3)

```

```{r}
summary(merged_us3$CG_AGE1)
merged_us3 |> filter(is.na(CG_AGE1))
merged_us3 |> filter(is.na(P_AGE1))
```

# Final US dataset (Sample size = 725)

```{r}
merged_us4_MildADonly<- merged_us3 |> 
  mutate(CG_AGE2 = ifelse(is.na(CG_AGE1), 90, CG_AGE1) ) %>% 
 select(-CG_AGE1)

table(merged_us4_MildADonly$CG_AGE2)

sapply(merged_us4_MildADonly, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))

```

# Final Japan Datset (Sample size = 553)

```{r renaming new variables}
merged_japan4 <- merged_japan1 %>% 
  rename( P_SEX = C_SEXCD, P_EDUC= C_EDUCCD, CG_SEX=C_CGSEXCD, CG_LIVEIN = C_CGLIVEIN, CG_OTHCG = C_CGNOTHCD, CG_REL = C_CGREL2CD, P_LIVLOC = C_LIVLOCCD, P_CC = C_NPCC, P_ALONE = C_ALONE, P_MARRIED = C_MARRIEDYN, COST_COSTPADM = COST_DMP, COST_COSTPADNM = COST_DNP, COST_COSTCADM = COST_DMC, COST_COSTCAINM= COST_INC_OP_C24  ) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(SEVGEUCD), !is.na(ZBITOTB), !is.na(C_AGE), !is.na(P_SEX), !is.na(P_EDUC), !is.na(C_CGAGE), !is.na(CG_SEX), !is.na(CG_LIVEIN), !is.na(CG_OTHCG), !is.na(CG_REL), !is.na(P_LIVLOC), !is.na(P_CC), !is.na(P_ALONE), !is.na(P_MARRIED), C_CGAGE != ".") %>% 
  mutate (P_AGE = ifelse(C_AGE == ">89", "90", C_AGE),
          P_AGE1 = as.numeric(P_AGE),
          CG_AGE1 = ifelse(C_CGAGE == ">89", "90", C_CGAGE),
          CG_AGE2 = as.numeric(CG_AGE1),
          P_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(P_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 65 & P_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 75 & P_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          CG_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(CG_AGE2 <65, "1", ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 65 & CG_AGE2 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 75 & CG_AGE2 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
         P_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(P_SEX == "0" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_SEX== "0" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_OTHCG1=as.factor(ifelse(CG_OTHCG==0, "0", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 2, "2", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         P_CC1=as.factor(ifelse(P_CC==0, "0", ifelse(P_CC == 1, "1", ifelse(P_CC == 2, "2", ifelse(P_CC == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         CG_LIVEIN1= as.factor (ifelse(CG_LIVEIN == "Y" , "1", "2")),
         SEVGRP= as.factor(ifelse(SEVGEUCD == 1, "1", ifelse(SEVGEUCD == 2, "2", "3"))),
         P_EDUC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_EDUC %in% c(1,2), "1", "2")),
         P_LIVLOC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_LIVLOC == 1, "1", "2")),
         P_ALONE1= as.factor(ifelse(P_ALONE == 0, "0", "1")),
         P_MARRIED1= as.factor(ifelse(P_MARRIED == 0, "0", "1")),
         CG_REL1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_REL == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_REL == 2, "2", "3")))) %>% 
dplyr::select(SUBJID, COUNTRY, P_SEX1, P_AGE1, P_AGECAT, P_EDUC1, CG_AGE2, CG_AGECAT, CG_SEX1, CG_LIVEIN1, CG_OTHCG1, CG_REL1, COST_COSTPADM, COST_COSTPADNM, COST_COSTCADM, COST_COSTCAINM, ZBITOTB, MMSETOTB)
dim(merged_japan4)
#View(merged_japan4)
```

# Cleaning the dataset

```{r cleaning dataset}
merged_spain2 <- merged_spain1 %>%
  rename(P_AGE = ENTAGE.x, P_SEX = SEXLNM.x, COUNTRY = COUNTRYL, CG_SEX = SEXLNM.y, CG_AGE = ENTAGE.y, CG_REL = DMRELLNM, CG_LIVEIN = CWTPTLNM, SEVGRPCD = TRTSORT, ZBITOTB = ZBIRN, CG_OTHCG = RUDRC, P_EDUC = EDCRN, MMSETOTB = MMSERN) %>%
  filter(!is.na(P_AGE), !is.na(P_SEX), !is.na(CG_AGE), !is.na(CG_SEX), !is.na(CG_LIVEIN), !is.na(CG_OTHCG), !is.na(CG_REL), !is.na(ZBITOTB), !is.na(SEVGRPCD)) %>% 
   mutate (P_AGE= ifelse(P_AGE == ">89", "90", P_AGE),
           P_AGE1= as.numeric(P_AGE),
           CG_AGE= ifelse(CG_AGE == ">89", "90", CG_AGE),
           CG_AGE2= as.numeric(CG_AGE),
          P_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(P_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 65 & P_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 75 & P_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          CG_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(CG_AGE2 <65, "1", ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 65 & CG_AGE2 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 75 & CG_AGE2 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          P_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(P_SEX == "Male" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_SEX== "Male" , "1", "2")), 
         P_EDUC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_EDUC <= 12, "1", "2")),
         CG_OTHCG1=as.factor(ifelse(CG_OTHCG==0, "0", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 2, "2", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         SEVGRP= as.factor(SEVGRPCD),
         CG_LIVEIN1= as.factor (ifelse(CG_LIVEIN == "Yes" , "1", "2")),
         CG_REL1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_REL %in% c("Husband", "Wife"), 1, ifelse(CG_REL == "Child", 2, 3)))) %>%
dplyr::select(SUBJID, COUNTRY, P_SEX1, P_AGE1, CG_AGE2,CG_SEX1, CG_LIVEIN1, CG_OTHCG1, CG_REL1, ZBITOTB, COSTQSNUM, COSPR1RN, P_AGECAT, CG_AGECAT, P_EDUC1, MMSETOTB)
dim(merged_spain2)
```

# Final merge: Longer format to wider format dataset

```{r merge final}
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = COSTQSNUM,
    values_from = COSPR1RN,
    names_prefix = "COST_")
dim(merged_spain4)
```

## Merged Geras-II (italy) dataset
```{r merged datasets}
merged_italy1 <- merge(merge(merge(merge(merge(merge(merge(despat_italy2, descar_italy2, by = "SUBJID"), desc_italy2, by = "SUBJID"), zbi_italy2, by = "SUBJID"), rud_italy2, by = "SUBJID"), cost_italy2, by="SUBJID"), educ_italy2, by="SUBJID"), mmse_italy2, by="SUBJID")
dim(merged_italy1)
```
# Cleaning the dataset

```{r}
merged_italy2 <- merged_italy1 %>%
  rename(P_AGE = ENTAGE.x, P_SEX = SEXLNM.x, COUNTRY = COUNTRYL, CG_SEX = SEXLNM.y, CG_AGE = ENTAGE.y, CG_REL = DMRELLNM, CG_LIVEIN = CWTPTLNM, SEVGRPCD = TRTSORT, ZBITOTB = ZBIRN, CG_OTHCG = RUDRC, P_EDUC = EDCRN, MMSETOTB = MMSERN) %>%
  filter(!is.na(P_AGE), !is.na(P_SEX), !is.na(CG_AGE), !is.na(CG_SEX), !is.na(CG_LIVEIN), !is.na(CG_OTHCG), !is.na(CG_REL), !is.na(ZBITOTB), !is.na(SEVGRPCD)) %>% 
   mutate (P_AGE = ifelse(P_AGE == ">89", "90", P_AGE),
          P_AGE1= as.numeric(P_AGE),
          CG_AGE= ifelse(CG_AGE == ">89", "90", CG_AGE),
          CG_AGE2= as.numeric(CG_AGE),
          P_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(P_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 65 & P_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 75 & P_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          CG_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(CG_AGE2 <65, "1", ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 65 & CG_AGE2 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 75 & CG_AGE2 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          P_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(P_SEX == "Male" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_SEX== "Male" , "1", "2")), 
         P_EDUC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_EDUC <= 12, "1", "2")),
         CG_OTHCG1=as.factor(ifelse(CG_OTHCG==0, "0", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 2, "2", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         SEVGRP= as.factor(SEVGRPCD),
         CG_LIVEIN1= as.factor (ifelse(CG_LIVEIN == "Yes" , "1", "2")),
         CG_REL1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_REL %in% c("Husband", "Wife"), 1, ifelse(CG_REL == "Child", 2, 3)))) %>%
dplyr::select(SUBJID, COUNTRY, P_SEX1, P_AGE1, CG_AGE2,CG_SEX1, CG_LIVEIN1, CG_OTHCG1, CG_REL1, ZBITOTB, COSTQSNUM, COSPR1RN, P_AGECAT, CG_AGECAT, P_EDUC1, MMSETOTB)
dim(merged_italy2)
```

# Currencies for US and Japan are in USD. The currencies for Spain, Italy and GERAS-EU are available in Euro. We converted the currency Euroes to USD for Spain and Italy datasets to merge all four datasets effectively. 

```{r}
datadir <- project_dir(c("data", "20251029_7c"), envvar = "ADCOST_DATA_DIR", create = TRUE)
```

```{r}
merge_opt = "1"
# 1: merge original data
# 2: merge plus data (with additional covariates)
```


# load existing datasets
```{r}
if (merge_opt == "1") {
  load(paste0(datadir,"EU.RData"))
  load(paste0(datadir,"US_MildADonly.RData"))
  load(paste0(datadir,"Geras-Japan.RData"))
  load(paste0(datadir,"Italy.RData"))
  load(paste0(datadir,"Spain.RData"))
}else if (merge_opt == "2") {
  load(paste0(datadir,"EU_plus.RData"))
  load(paste0(datadir,"US_MildADonly_plus.RData"))
  load(paste0(datadir,"Geras-Japan_plus.RData"))
  load(paste0(datadir,"Italy_plus.RData"))
  load(paste0(datadir,"Spain_plus.RData"))
  
  merged_eu4 <- merged_eu4_plus
  merged_us4_MildADonly <- merged_us4_MildADonly_plus
  merged_japan4 <- merged_japan4_plus 
  merged_spain4 <- merged_spain4_plus
  merged_italy4 <- merged_italy4_plus
}

```


# Normalizing EU Cost Variables 
```{r}
# Normalize Caregiver Informal Care Costs
merged_eu5 <- merged_eu4 %>% 
  group_by(COUNTRY) %>%
  mutate(norm_cainm = (COST_COSTCAINM - mean(COST_COSTCAINM)) / sd(COST_COSTCAINM),
         norm_cadm = (COST_COSTCADM - mean(COST_COSTCADM)) / sd(COST_COSTCADM)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
merged_analysis2 <- merged_analysis %>% 
  mutate(COST_COSTCAINM = ifelse(COUNTRY == "FRANCE", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["FR"] * US_rate["FR"], ifelse(COUNTRY == "GERMANY", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["DE"] * US_rate["DE"], 
ifelse(COUNTRY == "UNITED KINGDOM", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["UK"] * US_rate["UK"],                    ifelse(COUNTRY == "ITALY", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["IT"] * US_rate["IT"],                    ifelse(COUNTRY == "SPAIN", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["SP"] * US_rate["SP"],                    ifelse(COUNTRY == "US", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["US"] * US_rate["US"],
ifelse(COUNTRY == "Japan", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["JP"] * US_rate["JP"],
COST_COSTCAINM_orig))))))),

  COST_COSTCADM = ifelse(COUNTRY == "FRANCE", COST_COSTCADM_orig * IF_rate["FR"] * US_rate["FR"], ifelse(COUNTRY == "GERMANY", COST_COSTCADM_orig * IF_rate["DE"] * US_rate["DE"], 
ifelse(COUNTRY == "UNITED KINGDOM", COST_COSTCADM_orig * IF_rate["UK"] * US_rate["UK"],                    ifelse(COUNTRY == "ITALY", COST_COSTCADM_orig * IF_rate["IT"] * US_rate["IT"],                    ifelse(COUNTRY == "SPAIN", COST_COSTCADM_orig * IF_rate["SP"] * US_rate["SP"],                    ifelse(COUNTRY == "US", COST_COSTCADM_orig * IF_rate["US"] * US_rate["US"],
ifelse(COUNTRY == "Japan", COST_COSTCADM_orig * IF_rate["JP"] * US_rate["JP"],
COST_COSTCADM_orig)))))))
)
```
